enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan running to cope with the warm conditions
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet over the legs. Turn the head to the side. Turn the body onto the right side. Stretch the left arm out. Pull the arm back under the sheet. Turn the body onto the left side. Press the fan button to keep it running. Roll onto the back. Place both hands on the chest. Turn the head to the other side. Bend the knees. Straighten the legs. Turn the body onto the right side again. Pull the sheet up to the shoulders. Remain still on the bed with eyes closed until the alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet and taking a cool shower, brushing teeth and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Open the eyes. Reach the right hand to the phone on the bedside table. Press the phone screen to stop the alarm. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Turn on the bathroom light. Lift the toilet lid. Sit on the toilet. Stand up. Press the flush button. Lower the toilet lid. Walk to the shower. Turn the shower handle to cold. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the arms and shoulders. Rinse the body. Turn the shower handle off. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the rail. Wipe the face and hair with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rail. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Wipe the mouth with the towel. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast with the toaster, fruit, iced water) and boiling the kettle for tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread and fruit. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Take a plate from the cupboard. Put the fruit on the plate. Open the freezer compartment. Take out ice cubes. Drop the ice cubes into a glass. Fill the glass with water from the tap. Place the glass on the counter. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Pick up a knife. Cut the fruit on the plate. Press the toaster lever up when the toast pops. Pick the toast out of the toaster. Put the toast on the plate. Sit down at the table. Pick up the toast. Eat the toast. Pick up the fork. Eat the fruit. Pick up the glass. Drink the iced water. Stand up. Pour the boiled water from the kettle into a cup. Place a tea bag into the cup. Carry the cup to the table. Sit down. Pick up the cup. Drink the tea. Stand up. Place the cup, plate and fork into the sink. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into light work clothes, packing a bag with a water bottle, hat and sunscreen, and checking phone messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a light shirt. Take out light trousers. Take off the house clothes. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Sit on the bed. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie the shoelaces. Stand up. Pick up the bag from the chair. Open the bag zip. Walk to the kitchen and take the water bottle from the counter. Place the water bottle into the bag. Take the hat from the hook and place it into the bag. Take the sunscreen bottle from the shelf and place it into the bag. Close the bag zip. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the phone screen. Scroll through the message list with the thumb. Open a message. Type a reply with both thumbs. Press send. Press the phone screen off. Place the phone into the trouser pocket. Pick up the bag. Switch off the fan. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office by walking and public transport, taking shade breaks in the heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the front door. Pull the door shut. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the bag. Walk along the pavement to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the water bottle from the bag. Twist the cap open. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Put the bottle back into the bag. Step under the shop awning to stand in the shade. Step back to the kerb when the bus arrives. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Stand up at the stop. Walk to the bus front door. Step off the bus. Walk along the shaded side of the street. Stop under a tree. Take the hat from the bag. Put the hat on the head. Take the water bottle out. Drink water. Put the bottle back. Walk to the office building entrance. Push the glass door open. Walk to the lift. Press the lift button. Step into the lift. Press the floor button. Step out of the lift. Walk to the office door. Push the door open. Walk in.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering calls and emails, and meeting with partner organisations
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Place the bag on the floor. Take off the hat. Sit on the chair. Press the computer power button. Move the mouse. Type the login password on the keyboard. Open the email program. Click the inbox. Open the first email. Read the email. Click reply. Type a reply on the keyboard. Click send. Open the next email. Type a reply. Click send. Pick up the ringing desk phone. Press the answer button. Say 'Good morning, community programs office.' Listen to the caller. Write notes on the notepad with a pen. Say 'I will confirm the schedule and call you back.' Press the end call button. Place the phone on the desk. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Shake hands with the partner organisation representatives. Sit on a chair. Open the folder on the table. Point at the program calendar. Say 'The weekend event starts at ten on Saturday.' Turn the pages of the folder. Write on the notepad. Stand up. Shake hands again. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the water bottle. Drink water. Type notes into the computer. Open the calendar program. Type the event date into the calendar. Click save. Open the next email. Read it. Click reply. Type a reply. Click send. Pick up the phone. Press the answer button. Say 'Hello, community programs office.' Listen. Say 'Thank you, goodbye.' Press the end call button. Place the phone on the desk. Move the mouse. Click the spreadsheet. Type the participant numbers into the cells. Click save. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed pages. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Staple the pages with the stapler. Place the pages into the folder.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break, eating a packed meal in a cool indoor spot and drinking plenty of water
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Push the chair under the desk. Walk to the staff room. Sit on a chair at the table. Open the bag zip. Take out the lunch box. Place the lunch box on the table. Open the lunch box lid. Take out a fork. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice and vegetables. Chew the food. Pick up the water bottle. Twist the cap open. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Pick up the fork again. Eat the rest of the meal. Close the lunch box lid. Stand up. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the fork. Turn off the tap. Place the fork and lunch box into the bag. Close the bag zip. Walk to the water cooler. Place the bottle under the tap. Press the water button. Fill the bottle. Release the button. Twist the cap closed. Walk back to the desk. Sit on the chair. Move the mouse. Click the email program. Open the next email. Read it. Type a reply. Click send.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing office work: finalising the weekend community event plan, drafting schedules and updating program records on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Move the mouse. Click the event plan document. Type the event title on the keyboard. Type the venue name. Type the start time. Type the end time. Click the insert table button. Type the volunteer names into the table rows. Type the shift times into the table columns. Click save. Open the schedule template. Type the program names into the list. Type the dates. Click save. Open the records database. Click the first record. Type the updated participant name. Press the tab key. Type the updated phone number. Click save. Click the next record. Type the updated address. Click save. Pick up the desk phone when it rings. Press the answer button. Say 'Community programs office, how can I help?' Listen. Say 'Yes, the event is confirmed for Saturday.' Press the end call button. Place the phone on the desk. Open the water bottle. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Move the mouse. Click the calendar program. Drag the event block to the correct time slot. Click save. Open the email program. Open the unread email. Read it. Click reply. Type the confirmation text. Click send. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed schedule. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Read the printed schedule. Pick up the pen. Circle two lines. Type the corrections into the computer. Click save. Move the mouse. Click the shutdown button. Wait for the computer to turn off. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Pick up the bag. Walk to the office door. Push the door open. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the office by public transport and walking, avoiding the hottest part of the day where possible
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the lift. Press the lift button. Step into the lift. Press the ground floor button. Step out of the lift. Push the glass entrance door open. Walk along the shaded side of the street. Stop under the tree. Take the water bottle from the bag. Twist the cap open. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Put the bottle back into the bag. Walk to the bus stop. Stand under the shelter. Step onto the bus when it arrives. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Place the bag on the lap. Stand up at the stop. Walk to the front door. Step off the bus. Walk along the pavement. Cross the road at the crossing. Wait for the signal. Walk across. Walk to the front door of the house. Take the key from the bag. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the door open. Step inside. Close the door. Turn the key to lock the door. Take off the hat. Walk into the house.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing into light house clothes after the hot commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Take off the shirt and trousers. Place the clothes into the laundry basket. Take off the socks. Step into the shower. Turn the shower handle to cold. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the arms, chest and legs. Rinse the body. Turn the shower handle off. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair and body with the towel. Hang the towel on the rail. Pick up the house shirt from the hook. Put on the house shirt. Put on the house shorts. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker, then leaving the range hood running while cooking
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Press the range hood button on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Place the pieces into a bowl. Pick up the egg. Crack the egg on the bowl edge. Pour the egg into the bowl. Pick up the chopsticks. Beat the egg. Press the induction cooker power button. Press the heat button. Place the pan on the cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Wait for the oil to heat. Pour the egg into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the egg. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir with the spatula. Add salt from the shaker. Press the induction cooker power button off. Pick up the plate. Slide the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the food. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Place the plate into the sink. Pick up the pan. Place the pan into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate and pan. Turn off the tap. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Leave the range hood running. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on to stay cool
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Turn on the living room light. Pick up the air conditioner remote from the table. Press the power button. Press the temperature down button. Place the remote on the table. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the sofa arm. Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Press the phone screen. Scroll the message list with the thumb. Open a message. Type a reply. Press send. Press the phone screen off. Place the phone on the sofa cushion. Pick up the water bottle from the bag. Twist the cap open. Drink water. Twist the cap closed. Place the bottle on the table. Pick up the TV remote. Press the channel button. Press the volume down button. Place the remote on the sofa arm. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen door. Look at the range hood. Walk back to the sofa. Sit down. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button off. Place the remote on the table. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button off. Place the remote on the table. Stand up. Turn off the living room light. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and preparing iced tea and tomorrow's lunch supplies
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Pick up the plate from the table. Carry the plate to the sink. Place the plate on the counter. Pick up the glass. Place the glass on the counter. Wipe the table with the cloth. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Pick up the plate. Place the plate into the rack. Pick up the glass. Place the glass into the rack. Pick up the fork. Place the fork into the basket. Push the lower rack in. Add dishwashing powder to the dispenser. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher start button. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the tea bags and the vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Place a tea bag into a jug. Pour the boiled water into the jug. Open the freezer. Take out ice cubes. Drop the ice cubes into the jug. Place the jug into the refrigerator. Open the cupboard. Take out the lunch box. Place the lunch box on the counter. Take the bread from the bread bin. Place the bread into the lunch box. Cut the vegetables. Place the vegetable pieces into the lunch box. Close the lunch box lid. Place the lunch box into the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting at the desk with the desk lamp on, using the computer to review community program emails and volunteer rosters
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit on the chair at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch on. Press the computer power button. Wait for the screen to light up. Type the login password on the keyboard. Move the mouse. Click the email program. Open the first email. Read the email. Click reply. Type a reply on the keyboard. Click send. Open the next email. Read it. Click reply. Type a reply. Click send. Move the mouse. Click the roster spreadsheet. Scroll down with the mouse wheel. Click the first volunteer name cell. Type the updated shift time. Press the tab key. Type the next shift time. Click save. Scroll down. Click the next cell. Type the volunteer phone number. Click save. Pick up the phone from the desk. Press the phone screen. Open the message list. Type a message with both thumbs. Press send. Press the phone screen off. Place the phone on the desk. Move the mouse. Click the shutdown button. Wait for the computer to turn off. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up from the chair. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time wash: brushing teeth, washing face and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Turn off the tap. Place the toothbrush into the holder. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands. Pick up the face wash. Squeeze face wash onto the hand. Rub the hands together. Rub the face with both hands. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the rail. Pick up the comb. Comb the hair. Place the comb on the shelf. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, checking the phone and setting an alarm for tomorrow
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull the sheet back. Sit on the edge of the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the sheet over the legs. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the phone screen on. Scroll the message list with the thumb. Open a message. Type a reply with both thumbs. Press send. Press the home button. Open the clock app. Press the alarm tab. Press the add alarm button. Scroll the hour wheel to 6. Scroll the minute wheel to 40. Press the save button. Press the phone screen off. Place the phone on the bedside table. Press the fan button on. Turn the body onto the right side. Pull the sheet up to the shoulders. Close the eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan on and the door ajar to keep the room ventilated
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed with eyes closed. Turn the body onto the left side. Pull the sheet over the shoulder. Stretch the right arm out. Pull the arm back under the sheet. Turn the body onto the back. Place both hands on the chest. Turn the head to the side. Bend the knees. Straighten the legs. Turn the body onto the right side. Push the sheet down to the waist. Pull the sheet back up. Remain still on the bed. Keep the eyes closed. Keep the fan running. Leave the door ajar.
